messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped to ~430ms at ~10:11 UTC, while p50/p95 stayed flat. Console route view p99 shows ~190ms, so endpoints and routes disagree.

Josh: interesting. Any chance a quota or routing fallback fired? drop the exact console query you ran.

Maria: pasted the console query I used:
```
SELECT percentile(response_ms, [50,95,99])
FROM latency
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts >= '2024-05-05T10:05:00Z' AND ts <= '2024-05-05T10:20:00Z'
GROUP BY route, sample_origin
```

Kevin: FYI our route rollup path intentionally strips `sample_origin` (gateway/cache/backend) when merging t-digests. That removes the origin "stamp" and makes route-level p99 come from the high-volume gateway/cache samples. Endpoint/backend recompute can show a different tail.

Maria: that matches what I'm seeing: endpoint/backend p99 ~430ms, route p99 ~190ms. How should ops interpret this?

Liz: propose two UX bits: (1) an "origin stamp" badge next to each percentile (e.g., origin: mixed | backend-heavy) and (2) a confidence ribbon that surfaces effective sample N per-percentile with a short tooltip explaining low-N uncertainty.

Kevin: counts for the 10:05-10:20 window: gateway=1,150, cache_hit=980, backend=73. Backend has small N but contains the long tails.

Maria: exactly. With backend N ~73 it's noisy. Suggest we show `N_effective` and mark percentiles as low-confidence when N_effective < 100 so oncall doesn't page immediately.

Josh: actionable. I'll open a tracking ticket and add a runbook blurb: "If route p99 != endpoint p99, check sample_origin counts and N_effective before escalating." Tagging eng-platform + oncall.

incident-bot: quota-fallback triggered client=acme-corp at 2024-05-05T10:11:07Z — routing policy moved keys to fallback-model-v2.

Kevin: another contributing factor: recent gateway batching tweak skews short requests into larger batches, suppressing gateway-observed tails. Long-sequence requests often remain unbatched and surface in backend histograms. We might add sequence-length stratification to the latency pane.

Maria: repro steps I ran locally: POST /v1/generate with ~1800-2200 tokens and header `x-client:dedicated-client`. logs: `req=... backend_ms=427 seq_len=1900 cache=false`.

Liz: UX mock idea: show small badge + hover with per-origin counts and `N_effective` plus a one-line hint: "Low N -> percentile may be unreliable." Minimal visual: amber badge "low confidence" when N < 100.

Josh: sounds good. Liz — can you sketch a tiny PR (copy + tooltip + badge states)? Kevin — can you expose a short metric `percentile_effective_n` so console can ingest? I'll document in dashboard FAQ.

Liz: will spin up a tiny mock PR for the badge/tooltip and link it here once ready.

Kevin: will add the infra metric in next deploy.

Maria: thank you — this will save noisy wakeups. tagging @eng-platform for visibility. :eyes:
